title: The SMW port to Godot is almost complete
author: philsodyssey
selftext:
Hey Reddit and game devs. I am just about to complete a full port of Super Mario World to Godot in C#. I think some people started this but never finished it. 

I do plan on making this open source once I finish a few more tests. 

I'm hoping this is useful to the mod community for SMW. I for one see some a lot of advantages over classic ROM mods. 

Now some of you probably want to know cost and tokens usage to do this. Here is my answer : a lot. It struggled for the first 10-20 levels, and took a few weeks to have the game not freeze on new enemies/items ect..If I had to guess, at least $3-4k on tokens. I work on so many other projects it hard to say exactly what this costs. 

Here is my question for you. Should I release this anonymously? Consider that I will be releasing with a free modded version of the game. If I should release this anonymously, whats the best way to do so?
